description: Chart AI. Describe a chart in plain English via GET and get a rendered image back. Powered by AI. Credit cost: 10 credits per call.

background.description: Background color as a hex value. Default: #ffffff.

device_pixel_ratio.description: Device pixel ratio for the rendered image. Default: 1.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Output format. Default: "png". Allowed values: png, svg. Default: "png".

legend.description: Legend position or visibility. Use "false" to hide. Allowed values: top, bottom, left, right, chartArea, false. Default: "top".

prompt.description: Describe your chart in plain English (max 1000 chars). Be specific: mention chart type, data topic, colors, style.

raw_data.description: Raw data for the chart. URL-encoded string, CSV, or JSON. AI will parse and structure it.

share.description: Set share=true to persist the config and receive JSON instead of an image: { id, render_url, view_url, embed_url, expires_in }. Free plan: 3-day expiry with watermark. Paid plan: 6-month expiry, no branding. Default: false.

title.description: Override the chart title generated by AI.

name: chart_ai
title: Chart AI
